run_plot_benchmark: run the plot function to generate a horizontal bar chart of FPS benchmarks from profile data files
create_bench_plot: create a horizontal bar chart with error bars from FPS profile data and save as PDF
summarize_plot_function: summarize the plot function which reads FPS values from text files, computes mean and standard error, and generates a bar chart
review_plot_function: review the plot function that parses FPS from hab3 profile files and produces benchmark comparison charts
refactor_plot_function: refactor the plot function to accept configurable file paths instead of hardcoded data/profile/hab3 directory
